propositions: Contributor sign-off guidance in AGENTS.md and .agents/rules/rebar.md hardcodes a specific bot identity (joeoakhart+bot@navapbc.com) instead of directing contributors to use their own configured git identity, contradicting CONTRIBUTING.md policy.

Documentation must be made identity-neutral by instructing contributors to sign off with git config user.name and user.email, and Joe Oakhart bot identity must be retained only in automation-owned paths (infra/, .github/workflows/, tests/), not in contributor-facing guidance.

A deterministic build-time lint check must be added to prevent reintroduction of hardcoded personal sign-offs in contributor-facing documentation files, using git grep with pathspec magic to scan docs/ while excluding docs/experiments/.
